banner.saveFailed: The console cannot save its state file. Conversations are kept in memory only: a restart now would lose what happened since the last good save.
side.settingsTitle: Settings: seats, Telegram, phone access, features
side.foldAllTitle: Fold or expand every seat's conversation list
search.partial: The index is still being built: some older conversations may be missing for a few minutes.
conv.empty: New conversation. Write a task below.
conv.interrupted: Interrupted: the server restarted while this turn was running. Resume continues the same session.
conv.stopped: Stopped. Sending a message resumes this conversation.
conv.readonly: Read-only: this run lives on a remote server. Nothing can be sent from here.
conv.keptTitle: Kept: never auto-archived, stays visible when the seat is folded
conv.qwaitTitle: Stopped on the usage limit. The console sends it a continue message at this time.
conv.keepTitle: Never auto-archive it, and keep it visible when its seat is folded
conv.unkeepTitle: Let it auto-archive after 3 idle days and fold with its seat
conv.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation, its log and its uploaded images? This cannot be undone.
composer.placeholder: Message this seat. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
composer.placeholderTouch: Message this seat. Tap Send to send.
composer.confirmBypassStart: Bypass mode: this conversation runs EVERY tool without asking. Start it?
composer.confirmBypassSwitch: Bypass mode: this conversation runs EVERY tool without asking. Switch it?
ctx.title: Context window
ctx.noBreakdown: No breakdown yet. Refresh reads it from the CLI ({cmd}) while the conversation is idle.
ctx.compactPrompt: Compact this conversation. What should be kept? (optional)
usage.confirmUse: Use the {what} on {seat}? {effect} This cannot be undone.
usage.effectFable: It refills the 5-hour limit and the Fable allowance (not the whole week).
usage.effectAll: Its 5-hour and weekly windows start from zero.
pins.tooOld: That message is older than the loaded part: use “Load earlier” at the top.
routines.title: Routines
routines.decision.initial: past at first start, not asked
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: One brief, split into tasks; each task runs on the seat fixed for its discipline. A seat at its limit waits, it is never swapped.
projects.briefPh: Brief: what the whole project must deliver
projects.nothingRunning: Nothing running. Pick a folder or write a brief.
projects.confirmApprove: Start every task now, each on the seat fixed for its discipline?
projects.confirmCancel: Cancel this project? Nothing new starts; running conversations keep running until you stop them.
set.title: Settings
set.subtitle: What is set up on this computer and what is turned on.
set.first.title: Choose what to turn on
set.first.text: Go through the list. Optional features stay off until you turn them on; Save keeps your choices.
set.restartNote: Saved. Seats, remotes and disciplines change after a restart.
set.noSupervisor: No supervisor is running: Restart stops the console and you start it again yourself.
set.start.note: Everything here is optional except one signed-in seat. Nothing optional runs until you turn it on; the defaults are shown in each section.
set.lang.title: Language
set.lang.hint: The page and the Telegram bot. Browser language: the bot writes in English.
set.check.tgNotLinked: bot set, chat not linked yet
set.check.modelsNone: each seat uses its CLI default
set.signInOnce: Sign in once, in a terminal in the Seat Console folder: {cmd}
set.removeBlocked: Delete its conversations first (archived ones count too)
set.agentAdd: Add it as a seat to give it work like a Claude seat. A second account gets its own login folder.
set.emailPh: the account's e-mail (shown on the card)
set.seatNote: One seat = one Claude account you are entitled to use. After adding: sign it in with the command shown, then restart.
set.agyHint: Install the Antigravity CLI (agy) to {dir}, or point {env} at it, then run it once to sign in.
set.added: Added {name}. Sign it in once, in a terminal in the Seat Console folder: {cmd}
set.confirmRemoveSeat: Remove the seat {name} from seats.json? Its login folder stays on disk.
set.confirmRemoveRemote: Remove the remote {name}? Nothing on the server is touched.
set.confirmRestart: Restart the console now? Running conversations keep running and are picked up again.
set.confirmStop: No supervisor is running: the console stops and you start it again yourself. Stop it now?
set.tg.about: Telegram sends finished, failed and approval messages to your phone, and takes new tasks and replies from it.
set.tg.tokenHow: In Telegram, open {father}, send {cmd}, and copy the token it gives you. It is stored in the console's secrets file and never shown again.
set.tg.tokenReplacePh: a token is saved; paste a new one to replace it
set.tg.tokenSaved: Token saved. Now link your chat (step 2).
set.tg.linkedOnly: Linked. Only this chat can talk to the console.
set.tg.testInstance: A test instance never talks to Telegram.
set.tg.sendThis: Open your bot{bot} in Telegram and send:
set.tg.linkedShows: This page shows “chat linked” once it arrives (Refresh).
set.tg.codeSoon: The one-time link code appears here a few seconds after the token is saved (Refresh).
set.tg.digestsHint: At {morning} and {evening} Telegram gets a short summary of what each seat did, built from the console's own state (no model call).
set.access.test: A test instance is never bound to Tailscale and keeps the real page login: nothing to set here.
set.access.tsOff: Tailscale not found: the console answers on this computer only
set.access.openOnPhone: Open on your phone (same Tailscale account):
set.access.install: Install Tailscale on this computer and on the phone and sign both in to one account; the console finds it by itself within a minute (README: Phone access via Tailscale).
set.access.loginNote: From anything but this computer the page asks for a login. User: {user}. The page token (token.txt) is never shown here.
set.access.changed: Password changed. Other devices ask for it at their next visit.
set.usage.title: Usage
set.usage.metersHint: Every 3 minutes the console asks Anthropic for each Claude seat's 5-hour and weekly usage, with that seat's own sign-in (read-only), and shows it on the seat card.
set.usage.warnHint: One Telegram message when a seat passes {pct} of its 5-hour window. It never suggests another seat.
set.usage.claudeResetsHint: Reads the free limit resets a Claude account holds, from an undocumented endpoint that only answers the Claude CLI: the request identifies itself as the Claude CLI. Off: the plain usage request, no reset buttons.
set.usage.codexResetsHint: Reads a Codex account's free reset credits through its own CLI ({cmd}) and shows a Use button. Nothing is ever spent without your tap.
set.usage.archiveHint: A conversation untouched this many days moves to the archive (★ Keep excepted). 0 = never.
set.usage.reapHint: An idle conversation's process is stopped to free memory; the next message starts it again.
set.proj.title: Multi-sided projects
set.proj.pageHint: One brief is split into tasks by the owner seat; each task runs on the seat fixed for its discipline. Off hides the page; projects already running finish.
set.proj.rule: Each discipline has ONE fixed seat. A seat at its usage limit makes its tasks wait for the reset; they are never moved to another seat.
set.proj.owner: Owner (writes the plan, runs the integration)
set.rt.note: At the due time the console only asks on Telegram; a run starts on your tap there or on Run now in the sidebar.
set.rt.cronPh: cron: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 9 * * 1 = Mondays 09:00
set.rt.promptFile: This routine reads its prompt from a file: a prompt typed here replaces it.
set.rem.title: Remote servers
set.rem.note: A Linux machine reached over ssh with a key. Read-only: the console follows its run files. “May start conversations” also runs new conversations there (needs {cmd} once).
set.rem.mayStartHint: Otherwise read-only: only ls and tail run there.
set.rem.pathsPh: run files to follow, e.g. ~/runs/*-run.jsonl (read-only remotes)
set.rem.account: Its Claude login is the account of seat
set.models.title: Default model per seat
set.models.note: Used when a new conversation (also from Telegram, a routine or a project) is started with “default model”. Each list is that seat's own.
bot.desktopSession: This is a Claude desktop app session — the bot cannot continue it. Open it in the Claude app instead.
bot.unknownConversation: I do not know which conversation this message belongs to. Reply to a newer message.
bot.unknownCommand: Unknown command. {help} shows what there is.
bot.filesReply: Photos and files: reply to the notification of the conversation they belong to.
bot.photosConsoleOnly: Photos can only be sent through the console.
bot.nothingToSend: Nothing to send. Reply with text.
bot.nothingToSendMedia: Nothing to send. Reply with text, a photo or a file.
bot.linked: {name} linked. You will get finished, failed and approval messages here. {help} shows what you can send.
bot.file.tooBigTitle: File too big for the bot
bot.file.tooBig: Telegram lets a bot download up to 20 MB. Send it through the console (Attach).
bot.files.tooBig: {name} ({size}): too big for Telegram, open in console
bot.perm.tooLong: Too long to review here, so no buttons. Approve it in the console.
bot.help.plain: Plain message: I ask which seat gets it
bot.help.direct: {cmd}: straight to a seat, default model, auto ({seats})
bot.help.digest: morning digest (also sent on its own at {time})
bot.help.evening: evening digest (also sent on its own at {time})
bot.help.reply: Reply to a notification: continues that conversation
bot.help.compact: Reply to a notification with {cmd}: compacts the conversation context
bot.cmd.status: what happened in the last 24 hours
bot.cmd.seat: new task on {seat}: default model, auto mode
bot.cmd.digest: morning digest: usage, stuck, finished overnight, errors
bot.cmd.evening: evening digest: finished today, stuck, errors, tomorrow
bot.cmd.recover: conversations cut off by a crash: resume them
bot.cmd.routines: scheduled routines: next due, run now
bot.cmd.multi: multi-sided project: name | folder, the brief on the next lines
bot.list.title: Recent conversations
bot.multi.usageBrief: Then the brief on the next lines.
bot.multi.planReadyNote: When the plan is ready you get a message with an approve button.
bot.recover.title: Interrupted conversations
bot.status.title: Status
bot.status.noActivity: No activity in the last 24 hours.
bot.digest.lateWhy: the server was not available at {time}
bot.digest.skipped: {digest} of {time} was not sent: only the latest is sent
bot.routine.head: {seat} seat · due {time}
bot.routine.title: Routines
bot.routine.note: Nothing runs on its own: at the due time you get a question, and the run starts when you tap.
bot.server.saveFailed: Seat Console cannot write state.json (3 saves failed in a row). Conversations are kept in memory only until it works again.
bot.server.resumeFailed: the automatic resume after the usage limit failed 3 times: {error}
bot.server.testMessage: Test message from the Seat Console settings page.
bot.server.crashLoop: Seat Console is restarting after an uncaught error (twice within a minute). See server.err.log.
